Definition: Ajalon, the name of five places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Aijalon was a town in the valley where the sun stood still — Joshua cried, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon, and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon — and it was also a Levitical city, given to the Kohathites with its suburbs, and a place where Israel pursued the Philistines from Michmash. One name covers several towns, but the valley of Aijalon is the one the whole world remembers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the day the sun stood still over Aijalon shows me that God will stretch time itself to finish the victory he promised.
